name: Strung Up From The Sky
body:
School transmutation; Level druid 3, ranger 3, sorcerer/wizard 3

CAST

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M/DF (some string)

EFFECT

Range medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target 1 medium or smaller creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Reflex negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

The target of the spell is lifted up into the air up to 10 feet per two caster levels (maximum 50 feet). If the target hits a solid object above them (such as a ceiling), they stop there. They are stuck against the ceiling and are unable to move. Otherwise, the target hangs at a point in the air, still unable to move. They may make other actions, however. A successful Reflex save negates the effects of this spell. At the end of the spell, the target falls back downward.

Strung Up From The Sky, Mass

School transmutation; Level adept 4, antipaladin 4, bard 4, inquisitor 4, lathspell 4, legendary ninja 4, mesmerist 4, psychic 5, shaman 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch .

Targets one or more humanoid creatures, no two of which can be more than 30 ft. apart

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like strung up from the sky, except it affects multiple creatures.
